hero.name: Dinh Thang
hero.description: I build end-to-end web & mobile applications, linking intuitive user interfaces with scalable backend architectures, APIs, and databases.

about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am a Full-Stack Developer studying Information Technology at the University of Transport and Communications (UTC), passionate about building end-to-end software solutions—from intuitive frontend interfaces (React, Angular, Tailwind CSS) to secure Backend & API architectures (PHP/Laravel, MySQL, Redis).
about.p2: Leveraging production experience at Tino Tech Technology, my expertise focuses on RESTful API design, real-time WebSocket systems, Zalo Mini App & Mobile development, and database performance optimization.

workExperience.title: Professional Experience
responsibilities: Designing normalized database structures and high-performance RESTful APIs for Ionic mobile apps, Zalo Mini App, and multi-service web platforms.
Developing real-time geo-spatial matching algorithms for on-demand gigs using VietMap GL, Turf.js, and Marker Clustering alongside multi-branch enterprise ATS workflows.
Building closed-loop omnichannel F&B systems: QR table ordering, real-time Kitchen Display Systems, and automated inventory deduction based on recipe formulas.
Architecting goal-funded crowdfunding reward engines and real-time chat systems via WebSockets and Pusher, handling ticket escrow and transactional refunds.
Automating payment processing and transaction reconciliation via dynamic VietQR, SePay Webhooks, and VNPay, with role-based access control for multi-store SaaS architectures.

professionalSkills.title: Expertise & Technology
professionalSkills.footnote: Experienced in multi-service web, mobile, and SaaS systems.

aboutPage.title: About Me
aboutPage.subtitle: Full Stack developer building seamless frontend experiences and robust backend architectures.
aboutPage.storyP1: I am a Full-Stack Developer currently studying Information Technology at the University of Transport and Communications (UTC), passionate about transforming technical challenges into robust, production-ready software solutions.
aboutPage.storyP2: Since September 2025 at Tino Tech Technology, I have actively architected and developed production platforms including a multi-store e-commerce & F&B ecosystem on Zalo Mini App (EcoLuck) and an enterprise recruitment platform (JobGogo).
aboutPage.storyP3: I am dedicated to continuous learning, writing clean and maintainable code, optimizing database performance, and ensuring high system reliability across all deployments.
principles: Deliver seamless user experience backed by scalable code
Write clean, maintainable, and modular fullstack architectures
Automate background workers, queues, and deployments
Continuously measure, observe, and optimize performance
Enforce security and reliability across every application layer

journey.title: Began studying Information Technology at the University of Transport and Communications (UTC); built core foundations in algorithms, data structures, and web development (HTML/CSS, JS, PHP, MySQL).
Deep diving into Laravel MVC architecture, relational database design, and modern SPA frontend frameworks (ReactJS, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS).
Expanding into Hybrid Mobile development (Angular / Ionic, Capacitor), Zalo Mini App SDK, and real-time WebSockets.
Full-Stack Developer at Tino Tech Technology: architecting and launching production platforms including EcoLuck and JobGogo.
